title: Manager, Communications & Employer Brand, People Experience - Global Capability Center
description:
Location: Gurugram, India  

Date Posted: Mar 22, 2026

  

**Description**


**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
**The Team**
The Communications Manager supports the Global People Office (GPO) People Experience (PX) team by delivering clear, consistent, and well\-executed communications that strengthen the employee experience and reinforce the firm’s people strategy. This role blends hands\-on execution with coordination, analytics, and continuous improvement across internal, external, and social channels. The Communications Manager partners closely with GPO and cross\-functional stakeholders to manage intake, prioritize requests, and ensure communications are timely, accurate, engaging, and easy to consume.
**How you will contribute**
1\. Communications Execution \& Operations:* Maintain and update core GPO communications trackers, including trackers for campaigns, call discussions, and ongoing initiatives.
* Lead and manage the New Managing Director (MD) email process, ensuring accurate content, timely delivery, appropriate approvals, and alignment with GPO messaging.
* Partner with stakeholders to review incoming requests, confirm scope, and prioritize work based on business needs, timelines, and available capacity.
* Populate and maintain campaign briefs, ensuring objectives, audiences, timelines, governance, and approvals are clearly documented.
* Populate PX presentation slides for Leadership, ensuring consistency in messaging, formatting, and visuals.
* Create agendas and meeting summaries for recurring GPO meetings, capturing key decisions, actions, risks, and follow\-ups.
* Provide flexible support for PX special projects as business priorities evolve.


2\. Creative Channel Management:* Serve as Creative Lead for GPO communications, owning imagery, templates, formats, and banners to ensure visual consistency and alignment with brand standards.
* Manage the Instagram intake process, ensuring all required components are received, drafting copy, selecting photos, and routing content through approvals.
* Schedule approved social media posts and share live links with requestors to help boost engagement and visibility.
* Monitor external platforms (e.g., Glassdoor, Indeed, Fishbowl) for negative, sensitive, or reputationally impactful commentary, escalating themes and insights to appropriate stakeholders.


3\. Analytics, Insights \& Optimization:* Own and maintain the GPO analytics dashboard, tracking performance across channels and campaigns.
* Analyze survey data, engagement metrics, and sentiment signals to identify trends and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitor analysis and A\&M sentiment analysis related to the employer brand, summarizing insights and opportunities for improvement.
* Apply learnings from analytics and feedback to continuously refine messaging, formats, and processes.


4\. Technology, Tools \& Process Improvement:* Test, maintain, and support ongoing improvements to the GPO AI tool, ensuring accuracy, usability, and appropriate governance.
* Serve as the point of contact (POC) for GPO creative requests, coordinating inputs, timelines, approvals, and responses.
* Support the build\-out and ongoing refinement of internal and external communications intake and approval processes to improve efficiency, clarity, and consistency.
* Demonstrate adaptability
**Qualifications*** 5\+ years supporting internal, external, and social communications within a corporate, professional services, or HR\-focused environment.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Excellent writing, editing, and content development skills, with strong attention to detail and quality.
* Comfort working with analytics, dashboards, survey data, and performance metrics to inform communications decisions.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive, confidential, or reputationally impactful content.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to provide guidance rather than simply execute requests.
* Awareness of global audiences and cultural considerations when supporting people\-related communications.
* Flexibility and willingness to jump in where needed to support evolving GPO priorities.

**Your journey at A\&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.  


**Inclusive Diversity**
-----------------------


A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A\&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A\&M way.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------


It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. .


**Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters**
----------------------------------------------------


Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Core Roles \& Responsibilities1\. CAD Modeling and Drafting

This is the "bread and butter" of a junior designer. You will spend a significant portion of your time creating digital blueprints.

* **3D Modeling:** Developing detailed 3D parts and assemblies using software like SolidWorks, CATIA, or Creo.
* **2D Technical Drawings:** Converting 3D models into 2D shop drawings with proper views, sections, and annotations.
* **GD\&T Application:** Applying **Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing** to ensure parts fit together correctly during assembly.

2\. Design Documentation \& Management

Engineering is as much about the "paper trail" as it is about the hardware.

* **BOM Creation:** Maintaining the **Bill of Materials** (BOM), ensuring every nut, bolt, and custom part is accounted for.
* **Engineering Change Notices (ECN):** Documenting modifications made to existing designs to improve performance or reduce costs.
* **Technical Reports:** Assisting in writing manuals or assembly instructions for the manufacturing floor.

3\. Analysis and Validation

Before a part is made, you have to prove it won't fail.

* **FEA Support:** Performing basic **Finite Element Analysis** to check for stress points or deformations under load.
* **Tolerance Stack\-up:** Calculating how small variations in part sizes might affect the final assembly.
* **Prototyping:** Working with 3D printers or CNC shops to create physical samples for testing.

4\. Collaboration and Manufacturing Support

You act as the bridge between an idea and a physical object.

* **DFM/DFA:** Learning to design for **Manufacturability and Assembly**, ensuring parts aren't unnecessarily difficult or expensive to build.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Communicating with suppliers to source standard components (like bearings or motors) and checking their specifications.
* **Cross\-functional Meetings:** Sitting in on design reviews with senior engineers to learn how to defend your design choices.

title: Senior Manager HR
description:
**Senior Manager HR, HR Business Partner,** 




  





 Join a PE\-backed B2B software business in the fraud prevention and digital risk space, hiring its senior HR leader for India as the region scales rapidly.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on HRBP role supporting high\-performing engineering and product teams, with real ownership, senior stakeholder exposure, and the chance to shape how the India organisation grows. If you enjoy partnering with technical leaders, tightening operating discipline, and building strong people foundations in a fast\-paced environment, this one is worth a look.
 



  





**Company snapshot** 




 A global enterprise software company operating in fraud prevention and authentication for banking and payments. Profitable, well\-backed, and investing heavily in product innovation and growth. International footprint, remote\-first ways of working, and a leadership team that expects high standards and clear execution.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 India is the fastest\-growing region and the current HR setup is not scaling with hiring volume and leadership needs.
 



  





 The business needs a more senior HRBP who can influence engineering leaders, bring structure to recruitment and talent practices, and improve consistency across the employee lifecycle.
 



  





 This is a newly created role, designed to add strategic depth and day to day execution power in\-region.
 



  





**About the role** 




 You will be the senior HR partner for India, supporting circa 120 FTEs today and growing, largely across technology and product innovation teams.
 



  





 You will lead end\-to\-end HR delivery, while also building leadership capability, improving hiring discipline, and strengthening the employee experience.
 



  





 You will manage and develop a regional HR Generalist/Recruiter, and partner closely with global HR leadership.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Partner with India and global leaders on org design, workforce planning, leadership coaching, and talent strategy
* Drive performance management, talent reviews, development planning, and succession conversations
* Lead employee relations and complex advisory cases with strong judgement and consistency
* Bring structure to recruitment, including intake discipline, hiring manager alignment, and process adherence
* Coach leaders on effective people management, feedback, and decision\-making
* Improve HR operations in\-region, including data accuracy, policy application, and programme delivery
* Use HR metrics to identify trends in attrition, engagement, and workforce planning, then act on them
* Lead engagement and culture initiatives locally, working closely with global programmes
* Develop and upskill the regional HR team member, raising quality, pace, and consistency



  





**Ideal candidate profile** 



* Strong HRBP or HR leadership experience in India, ideally supporting technology, product, or engineering organisations
* Credibility and confidence partnering with senior technical leaders, able to influence and challenge when needed
* Proven strength in recruitment leadership and process design, particularly for technical hiring
* Prior people management experience, not a first\-time manager
* Solid grounding in India employment law and hands\-on employee relations
* Comfortable operating in a global environment, communicating clearly with international stakeholders
* Practical, sleeves\-rolled\-up approach, you can diagnose problems and fix them, not just advise



  





**Location and working style**

title: Quality Control - DET
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Diploma Trainee Engineer – Quality Control supports quality assurance activities by assisting in inspection, testing, and documentation of manufactured components. This role provides hands\-on training in quality control processes, measurement techniques, and compliance with applicable standards under the supervision of experienced quality engineers.
   

  

**Work You’ll Do**
* Assist in inspection and measurement of components using basic quality tools and instruments.
* Support incoming, in\-process, and final inspection activities as per quality plans.
* Help identify non\-conformities and report deviations to senior quality engineers.
* Assist in maintaining inspection records, reports, and quality documentation.
* Support implementation of quality procedures, work instructions, and SOPs.
* Follow safety, quality, and housekeeping standards on the shop floor.


**Team**
 This role will be part of the Quality Assurance and Control team within the manufacturing facility, working closely with production, engineering, and senior quality personnel to ensure products meet defined quality standards.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Diploma in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering or related discipline.
* Fresher or up to 1 year of industrial training or quality\-related experience.
* Basic understanding of engineering drawings and measurement concepts.
* Familiarity with measuring instruments such as vernier calipers and micrometers.
* Willingness to learn quality processes and work in a manufacturing environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to quality control practices through internship or apprenticeship.
* Basic knowledge of quality standards such as ISO 9001\.
* Awareness of shop\-floor inspection and manufacturing processes.
* Good communication skills and attention to detail.


**Who We Are**
 Milacron is a global leader in the manufacture, distribution and service of highly engineered and customized systems within the $27 billion plastic technology and processing industry. We are the only global company with a full\-line product portfolio that includes hot runner systems, injection molding, extrusion equipment. We maintain strong market positions across these products, as well as leading positions in process control systems, mold bases and components, maintenance, repair and operating (“MRO”) supplies for plastic processing equipment. Our strategy is to deliver highly customized equipment, components and service to our customers throughout the lifecycle of their plastic processing technology systems.

We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. **About Business Line/Function**
 The Global Markets (GM) business of BNP Paribas helps its Corporate and Institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7\.
   

  

 IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications.
   

  

 The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis \& Project Management, Development \& Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore \& Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
**The Lead Business Analyst, Global Market OTC Derivative will be a key contributor to the firm’s strategic initiatives, acting as a liaison between front\-office trades, operations, risk management, and technology teams. This role requires a deep, end\-to\-end understanding of the OTC derivatives trade lifecycle, from execution and trade capture to settlement, valuation, and regulatory reporting. The successful candidate will lead the analysis and delivery of complex IT solutions and process improvements that support and enhance the global OTC trading desk.**
**These applications are manned by a team of Business Analysts, Developers and Testers, spread across London, Paris, Singapore and India, with program management in London. The team is made of very senior technicians and analysts globally, who create tools and support the functional application teams by being leaders on matters of technology.**
**Agile Scrum methodology has followed as SDLC. The position will be working as a part of the scrum taking on roles of Business analyst or Scrum master as required.**
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Project Leadership: Lead and manage complex project for OTC derivative business initiatives from ideation to delivery, working in an Agile.

* Trade Lifecycle Management: Utilize extensive knowledge of the OTC trade lifecycle, including trade booking, confirmation, clearing, settlement, collateral management, and other post\-trade events.
* Regulatory Compliance: Translate complex global regulatory requirement (e.g. EMIR, DF, MiFID, KRX and so on) into functional system requirement and implement solution that ensure compliance.
* Quality Assurance and Testing: Oversee and participate in the creation and execution of detailed test cases and user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate that solution meet business requirements.
* Mentorship and Coaching: Guide and mentor team members on derivative products and best practices for system analysis and delivery.


**Continuous Improvement:** 
 Proactively monitor market trends, technology, and industry best practices to recommend and implement process and system enhancements.

* Team player.

* Open to new technology adaptions, learning and implementation within the project.
* Maintain the team practices and processes, retrospectives.
* Status reporting to technical and functional managers.

* Working experience in Financial Markets \& Trading Platforms (OTC derivative products predominantly Interest Rate Derivatives), Trade Life Cycle and familiarity with underlying data.
* Understanding of Front Office/Middle Office/ Back\-office functions.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills \- Understand and efficiently analyze information/requirements from multiple sources.

title: Manager, GFS Service Management
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.**Manager \- GFS Service Management**
Hello. We’re Haleon. A new, world\-leading, and fast\-moving consumer healthcare company. Shaped by all who join us. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people, by growing and innovating our global portfolio of category\-leading brands – including Crocin, Eno, Iodex, Otrivin and Centrum in India – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. What’s more, we’re achieving it in a company that we’re in control of. In an environment that we’re cocreating. And a culture that’s uniquely ours. Care to join us. It isn’t a question.
This is an exciting time to join and help shape the future of the world’s newest and largest consumer healthcare company, that’s 100% focused on everyday health. Come and be part of something special.
Our Haleon Global Capability Centre (GCC), located in Bengaluru, India is rapidly expanding with exciting new positions being created in multiple functions.
At Haleon GCC we bring global value to our organisation, delivering complex enterprise solutions while driving digital transformation and innovation. The Finance, Digital \& Technology, HR and Procurement functions are co\-located, and work with colleagues and partners around the world. The increasing range of activities and roles based in the GCC will offer you great potential for career progression and take part in shaping the future of the GCC.**What This Role Delivers?**
The Manager, GFS Service Management, is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end performance, governance, and contractual compliance of Global Finance Services (GFS) outsourced partners as well as GFS operational teams. The role drives operational excellence, performance insights, vendor management, risk management and forward\-looking decision support for GFS leadership, ensuring alignment with Haleon’s strategic and operational goals.
This role also plays a critical part in strengthening service performance visibility, driving accountability across internal and external partners, and enabling continuous improvement across GFS operations.**Key Responsibilities**
In terms of the role, you can expect the GFS Service Management to undertake the following:
1\.Contract Management* Ensure successful contract execution by overseeing timely and within\-budget completion of all deliverables and proactively resolving risks or disputes.
* Serve as the single point of contact between the business and vendor for Service Management discussions.
* Own the third party Contract Change Request process and governance, ensuring clarity and adherence.
* Provide support to the GFS LT \& ELT by interpreting contractual clauses with clear business impact assessments, in partnership with Procurement
* Identify and mitigate contractual risks, ensuring full compliance.
* Review and challenge vendor KPI reporting to ensure alignment with contractual definitions and calculations.
* Drive adoption of standardised contract governance practices across regions to ensure consistency.


2\.Performance Management \& Governance* Actively review and monitor GFS performance, including Genpact performance and GFS Operational teams, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Continuously evolve GFS Management Review Boards \- refining meeting structures, inputs, and outputs.
* Support restructuring the GFS scorecard and aligning metrics with OMP (Operational Master Plan) goals.
* Drive performance conversations proactively between governance meetings.
* Ensure the new Genpact contract constructs deliver performance and productivity outcomes.
* Maintain full visibility into Genpact billings, exceptions, Change Requests, productivity, and R\&R mechanisms.
* Integrate billing, CRs, productivity, and reward mechanisms into monthly performance meetings.
* Collaborate with Contracting Lead on reviews and provoke targeted value discussions.
* Ensure stakeholders understand how to leverage contractual constructs to maximize benefits.
* Reassess KPIs quarterly or earlier if deviations persist for 3 consecutive months.
* Drive productivity assessments every 6 months with documented commitments.
* Introduce structured root‑cause analysis frameworks to strengthen operational performance insights.


3\.VOC (Voice Of Customer) monitoring* Own the VOC process including communications, distribution, consolidation, and action planning (Between BU and GFS ; between GFS and Genpact)


GFS Governance* Issue monthly GFS dashboards with root\-cause analysis and leadership\-level summaries.
* Evolve reporting from transactional to forward\-looking insights and recommendations.
* Establish standard reporting templates to ensure consistent storytelling across all service lines.

**Risk \& RAID Governance*** Manage JIRA GFS RAID access requests and maintain governance hygiene.
* Facilitate periodic risk review conversations across GFS stakeholders.

**Qualifications \& Skills*** Minimum 8 years of relevant experience
* Experience working in outsourced or hybrid operating models preferred.
* Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate data into insights.
* Demonstrated experience in Service Management, Vendor Management, or PMO roles within a global environment
* Demonstrate the ability to work autonomously and effectively establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a problem‑solving mindset.
* Capable of effectively planning for and managing multiple competing demands and priorities.
* Possesses a comprehensive understanding of steps necessary to initiate, implement, and engage in a significant organisational change effort within a matrix environment.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve results in a complex global setting and effectively solve intricate business and process challenges.
* Experience in collaborating with various internal teams and third‑party stakeholders.
* Proficient in making informed and decisive decisions.
* Ability to drive operational excellence through structured governance and performance improvement practices.
* Strong communication, vendor management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced Excel, PowerBI and performance analytics capability.
* Project and change management expertise (certification preferred).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and navigate complex global ecosystems


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Haleon we embrace our diverse workforce by creating an inclusive environment that celebrates our unique perspectives, generates curiosity to create unmatched understanding of each other, and promotes fair and equitable outcomes for everyone.
We’re striving to create a climate where we celebrate our diversity in all forms by treating each other with respect, listening to different viewpoints, supporting our communities, and creating a workplace where your authentic self belongs and thrives.
We believe in an agile working culture for all our roles. If flexibility is important to you, we encourage you to explore with our hiring team what the opportunities are.  

**Job Posting End Date**  


2026\-03\-31**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------


If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.**Note to candidates**
----------------------


The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Hotel Manager
description:
Job Description: Hotel Manager

Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced, dynamic Hotel Manager to lead the overall operations of our \[3\-5 star / boutique / luxury] hotel. As the key leader on property, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional guest experiences, driving operational efficiency, maximizing revenue, and building a high\-performing team. This is a hands\-on leadership role that demands strong business acumen, people skills, and a passion for hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee all hotel departments (Front Office, Housekeeping, Food \& Beverage, Sales, Maintenance, Finance, and HR) and ensure seamless day\-to\-day operations.
* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of 50–150\+ associates; conduct performance reviews, training programs, and succession planning.
* Deliver outstanding guest satisfaction scores (TripAdvisor, Google, internal surveys) and personally resolve escalated guest issues.
* Drive revenue through dynamic pricing, upselling strategies, corporate contracts, events, and banquet sales in coordination with the Sales \& Revenue team.
* Manage operating budgets, control costs (payroll, supplies, utilities), and achieve or exceed monthly and annual financial targets (RevPAR, GOP, ADR).
* Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, security, and compliance with local health, fire, and licensing regulations.
* Develop and execute annual marketing and business plans in collaboration with ownership or corporate office.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, OTA partners, and local community stakeholders.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and guest feedback to recommend service and product improvements.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly management reports for ownership/corporate leadership.

Requirements \& QualificationsEducation

* Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or equivalent (Master’s preferred).

Experience

* Minimum 5–8 years of progressive hotel experience with at least 2–3 years as Hotel Manager or Assistant General Manager in a 50\+ room property.
* Proven track record in revenue management, cost control, and team leadership.

Skills \& Competencies

* Strong leadership and people\-management skills with ability to inspire teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (fluency in English \+ local language required).
* Proficient in Opera / Fidelio, PMS, POS systems, and Microsoft Office (especially Excel).
* Solid understanding of financial statements (P\&L, budgets, forecasting).
* High emotional intelligence and crisis\-management ability.
* Guest\-obsessed mindset with a hands\-on “roll\-up\-the\-sleeves” attitude.

Preferred

* Experience with international hotel brands (IHG, Marriott, Hilton, Accor, etc.).
* Certification in revenue management, food safety, or hospitality leadership programs.
* Working knowledge of labor laws and union environments (if applicable).

What We Offer

* Competitive salary \+ performance bonus (up to 20–30% of annual CTC).
* Comprehensive benefits package (health insurance, accommodation/meals, transport, gratuity).
* Career growth opportunities within the group.
* Free meals while on duty and uniform.
* Dynamic work environment in a fast\-growing hospitality company.

Reporting LineReports directly to: Owner / Regional Director / Area General Manager

If you are a results\-driven hospitality professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and loves creating memorable guest experiences, we want to hear from you!

How to ApplyPlease send your updated resume and current salary details to \[email] with the subject line: “Hotel Manager Application – \[Your Name]”.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.*

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: In person

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Executive to join our Chartered Accountant firm in the  

role of Internal Financial Control Audit. The primary responsibility of this position is to perform  

comprehensive internal audits of our clients' financial systems, processes, and controls. The ideal candidate  

will be a qualified person with a strong background in auditing, risk assessment, and financial reporting.  

This role plays a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and effectiveness of our clients' internal  

controls.

1\. Internal Audit Execution: Plan and conduct internal audits of clients' financial systems,  

operations, and processes to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls.  

2\. Risk Assessment: Identify potential risks and control weaknesses in clients' financial processes.  

Evaluate the impact of these risks on the overall financial reporting and provide actionable  

recommendations for risk mitigation.  

3\. Compliance Monitoring: Ensure that clients' financial practices align with relevant accounting  

standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.  

4\. Process Improvement: Collaborate with clients to recommend improvements to their financial  

control procedures, workflows, and policies to enhance efficiency and reduce risks.  

5\. Client Communication: Clearly communicate audit findings, recommendations, and reports to  

clients' management and stakeholders. Assist clients in understanding the importance of internal  

controls and the benefits of implementing recommended changes.  

6\. Documentation: Prepare detailed audit workpapers, documentation, and reports to support audit  

findings and conclusions.  

7\. Professional Development: Stay abreast of industry best practices, regulatory changes, and  

advancements in audit methodologies. Continuously develop skills and knowledge to improve  

audit effectiveness.  

8\. Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with other audit team members to ensure timely and  

efficient completion of audit engagements.

1\. Semi Qualified Chartered Accountant/Certified Internal Auditor  

2\. 3\-5 years of experience in internal auditing, financial controls, or assurance services.  

3\. Knowledge of accounting principles, auditing standards, and internal control frameworks.  

4\. Familiarity with financial reporting standards, tax regulations, and relevant laws.  

5\. Analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.  

6\. Effective communication and presentation abilities, both written and verbal.  

7\. Ability to manage multiple engagements and prioritize tasks effectively.  

8\. Willingness to travel to client locations, as required.

description:
Mechanical engineers are versatile professionals who research, design, develop, build, and test mechanical and thermal systems, ranging from micro\-scale sensors to massive industrial machinery. Their core responsibility is to bridge the gap between scientific principles (like physics and math) and practical applications to solve real\-world problems. * **Analysis \& Simulation**: Performing Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to test stress, heat transfer, and fluid flow before physical production.
* **Prototyping \& Testing**: Developing physical prototypes (often using 3D printing or CNC machining) and conducting methodical experiments to validate performance and safety.
* **Manufacturing Oversight**: Collaborating with production teams to oversee the fabrication process, ensuring designs are manufacturable (DFM) and meet quality standards.
* **Maintenance \& Troubleshooting**: Investigating equipment failures, performing root cause analysis, and recommending design modifications to prevent future malfunctions. Workable \+9

* **Education**: A **Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering** is the standard entry\-level requirement. A Master's degree is often preferred for specialized R\&D roles.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Strong grasp of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, materials science, and kinematics.
* **Software Skills**: Proficiency in CAD/CAM/CAE software and mathematical computing tools like MATLAB or Excel.
* **Soft Skills**: Problem\-solving, analytical thinking, creativity, and the ability to communicate complex technical data to non\-technical stakeholders. Betterteam \+8

**Typical Work Environment**

* **Setting**: Primarily office\-based for design and analysis, with frequent visits to factories, workshops, or building sites to inspect equipment and oversee installations.
* **Collaboration**: Working in multidisciplinary teams alongside electrical engineers, project managers, software developers, and manufacturing personnel. Bureau of Labor Statistics (.gov) \+4

* **Library Management:** Build and maintain centralized component libraries (symbols, 3D STEP models, and footprints) compliant with **IPC\-7351** standards across both platforms.
* **Signal \& Power Integrity:** Perform basic SI/PI analysis to minimize crosstalk, EMI, and power\-rail noise, especially around sensitive **RFID/NFC frontends**.
* **DFM/DFA/DFT:** Conduct thorough **Design for Manufacturing** and **Assembly** reviews to ensure high yields and lower production costs at EMS providers.
* **MCAD Collaboration:** Coordinate with mechanical engineers to ensure PCB\-to\-Enclosure fitment using **Altium 365** or **KiCad’s STEP export** features.

**Technical Skills \& Qualifications**

* **EDA Expertise:** 6 months of experience with **Altium Designer** (Unified environment, ActiveBOM) and **KiCad** (Version 7\.0/8\.0\).
* **PCB Technology:** Expertise in **HDI (High\-Density Interconnect)**, micro\-vias, and complex layer stack\-up definitions.
* **RF Awareness:** Familiarity with PCB antenna design and isolation techniques for **NXP RFID/NFC** chipsets.

* **Version Control:** Proficiency in using **Git** for managing KiCad project files and **Altium 365** for cloud\-based versioning.

title: freelance wordpress developer
description:
1\. Position Overview

The WordPress Developer will be a part of the web development team and will assist in the design, development, customization, optimization, and maintenance of WordPress\-based websites and applications. This internship is designed to provide hands\-on, real\-world experience in WordPress development while working under the guidance of experienced developers and project managers.

The intern will gain exposure to modern web development practices, content management systems (CMS), front\-end and back\-end development concepts, website performance optimization, security best practices, and collaborative software development workflows. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates who are passionate about web technologies and eager to build a strong foundation in WordPress development.

2\. Key Objectives of the Internship

* To provide practical experience in developing and managing WordPress websites
* To help interns understand real\-world project workflows and development lifecycles
* To build technical competence in WordPress core, themes, plugins, and customization
* To develop problem\-solving, debugging, and optimization skills
* To enhance collaboration and communication skills within a professional development team

3\. Roles and Responsibilities3\.1 WordPress Development

* Assist in building, customizing, and maintaining WordPress websites based on project requirements
* Work with WordPress themes (both pre\-built and custom themes) to implement UI/UX designs
* Customize WordPress plugins and develop basic custom plugins when required
* Support the integration of third\-party tools, APIs, and plugins
* Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across devices and browsers

3\.2 Front\-End Development Support

* Write clean, well\-structured HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript code
* Assist in converting design mockups (Figma, Adobe XD, PSD) into functional WordPress pages
* Optimize website layouts for performance, usability, and accessibility
* Make UI enhancements based on user feedback and testing results

3\.3 Back\-End and CMS Support

* Assist in configuring WordPress core settings, custom post types, taxonomies, and fields
* Support PHP\-based WordPress customization tasks under supervision
* Help manage databases (MySQL) related to WordPress installations
* Participate in content migration, data imports, and backups

3\.4 Website Performance and Optimization

* Assist in optimizing website speed and performance using caching, image optimization, and best practices
* Identify and resolve basic performance bottlenecks
* Support SEO\-friendly development practices such as clean URLs, schema markup, and metadata integration

3\.5 Security and Maintenance

* Assist in implementing WordPress security best practices
* Help update WordPress core, themes, and plugins while ensuring site stability
* Monitor websites for common vulnerabilities and issues
* Participate in routine maintenance tasks and quality assurance testing

3\.6 Testing and Debugging

* Conduct functional, UI, and cross\-browser testing
* Identify bugs, errors, and inconsistencies and assist in resolving them
* Use debugging tools and browser developer tools to troubleshoot issues
* Document issues clearly for senior developers

3\.7 Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with designers, developers, content creators, and project managers
* Participate in daily or weekly stand\-ups, sprint meetings, and project discussions
* Maintain clear documentation for development tasks, changes, and workflows
* Follow coding standards, version control practices, and internal development guidelines

4\. Required Skills and Technical Knowledge4\.1 Core Technical Skills

* Basic to intermediate understanding of WordPress CMS
* Familiarity with WordPress themes, plugins, and dashboard functionality
* Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and basic JavaScript
* Basic understanding of PHP and how it is used in WordPress
* Familiarity with MySQL databases and CMS\-driven websites

4\.2 Tools and Technologies

* WordPress (latest versions)
* Code editors such as VS Code, Sublime Text, or similar
* Version control systems (Git/GitHub or GitLab – basic knowledge preferred)
* Page builders such as Elementor, Gutenberg, or WPBakery (optional but advantageous)

4\.3 Soft Skills

* Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality work
* Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines
* Good communication skills (written and verbal)
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment

5\. Educational Qualifications

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Web Development
* Software Engineering
* Or a related technical field
* Candidates from non\-technical backgrounds with demonstrable WordPress and web development skills are also encouraged to apply

6\. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

* Prior experience with WordPress projects (academic, freelance, or personal)
* Basic knowledge of SEO concepts and digital marketing integration
* Familiarity with REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG)
* Exposure to hosting environments, cPanel, or cloud hosting platforms

7\. Learning Outcomes and Growth Opportunities

By the end of the internship, the WordPress Developer Intern is expected to:

* Gain hands\-on experience in developing and managing live WordPress websites
* Understand professional development workflows and best practices
* Build a strong portfolio of WordPress\-based projects
* Improve coding, debugging, and optimization skills
* Develop confidence in working with clients, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams

High\-performing interns may be considered for:

* Internship extension
* Part\-time or full\-time WordPress Developer roles
* Advanced responsibilities on client and internal projects

8\. Performance Evaluation Criteria

Intern performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and accuracy of assigned development tasks
* Ability to learn and apply new concepts
* Adherence to timelines and instructions
* Communication and teamwork
* Problem\-solving and initiative

Regular feedback sessions will be conducted to support continuous improvement.

9\. Work Environment and Culture

* Collaborative and learning\-focused work environment
* Mentorship from experienced developers and technical leads
* Exposure to real\-world client projects and deadlines
* Encouragement of innovation, experimentation, and skill development
* Professional standards of conduct, confidentiality, and accountability

10\. Internship Benefits

* Hands\-on industry experience in WordPress development
* Certificate of Internship upon successful completion
* Letter of Recommendation or performance\-based referral (where applicable)
* Opportunity to work on real projects for real clients
* Flexible working hours (subject to organizational policy)
* Potential pre\-placement offer based on performance

11\. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated resume/CV
* Portfolio or links to WordPress projects (if available)
* A brief statement of interest explaining why they want to pursue a WordPress Developer Internship

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

* A basic technical assessment
* An interview (technical and/or HR)

No prior experience is necessary, either; freshers are welcome to apply!

* Assist management team in ensuring efficient progress of workflow and transforming business visions into reality

REQUIREMENTS:

* Good reading comprehension and at least basic communication skills (English)
* Familiarity with web technology and comfort with the Internet
* No college degree necessary; no prior work experience necessary – freshers are also invited to apply

  

PREFERENCES:

* Fluent in at least one regional Indian language
* Ability to excel in a metrics\-driven environment
* Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) software tools
* Experience with consumer\-facing, interactive web sites or mobile apps

* Team player with strong analytical and project management skills
* Organized and detail\-oriented individual who works well with deadlines
* Willingness to learn, switch roles as necessary, and to roll up one's sleeves to get a job done

Ideal for electrical or mechanical engineers, the position focuses on technical review, code compliance, and coordination with design teams to support timely approval of solar installations.

 The KGS journey has been one of consistent growth, with a current employee count of nearly 10,000 operating from four locations in India — Bengaluru, Gurugram, Kochi, Pune and Mumbai providing a range of Advisory and Tax\-related services to member firms within the KPMG network.
   

  

 As part of KPMG in India, we were ranked among the top companies to work for in the country for four years in a row by LinkedIn, and recognized as one of the top three employers in the region for women, as well as for policies on Inclusion \& Diversity by ASSOCHAM (The Associated Chambers of Commerce \& Industry of India).
   

  

**Team Overview**
 The position in discussion is with Integration \& Separation (I\&S), Technology in M\&A within the Deal Advisory group at KPMG Global Services (KGS), which is KPMG’s global delivery center and an integral part of the firm’s strategy to enhance innovation, build scalability, and improve profitability globally.
   

  

* KGS DA\&S has been providing solutions to KPMG member firms globally. By leveraging insights and applying best practices, the team helps create customized approaches to M\&A transactions. The team’s capabilities include Corporate Finance, Transaction Services, Strategy, Business Modelling, Accounting Advisory Services, Deal Advisory Research and Benchmarking.
* KPMG’s Integration \& Separation team (ISA) advises clients on executing the operational integrations of acquisitions or joint ventures, and separations of businesses, in the case of divestitures or sale. I\&S does this by taking an enterprise‑wide view of M\&A deals, across all the functions, to deliver value to our clients. In addition, team is also involved in pre\-deal Due Diligence on specific areas of business.


**Responsibilities**
 We are recruiting for Consultant in the HR M\&A team.
   

  

 Roles \& responsibilities
   

  

* Working with onshore colleagues to lead and provide support on a wide variety of M\&A projects including global programs from a people, workforce analytics and organization effectiveness perspective
* Support and sometimes lead work streams on HR I\&S projects, supporting client work stream leads to fulfil their work stream objectives
* Work with project teams to analyze workforce data by applying key analytical tools to provide key insights and suggest solutions to solve complex client challenges
* Demonstrate technical and analytical competence in a deal context for key HR aspects: HR Operations, Labor Relations \& Compliance, Organization \& Talent Management and Employee Experience and Day 1 comms
* Proactively co\-ordinate with onshore engagement teams to procure new engagements / engagement work, obtain clarifications, communicate progress and post\-delivery de\-brief and feedback
* Seek ownership for independent engagement and tasks and on larger engagements oversee the work of more junior team members
* Assist in the development and presentation of final project deliverables

**Qualifications**
 This role is for you if you have the below
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
* MBA / Bachelor’s degree in a related field from an accredited college/university preferably with major in Human resources


**Work Experience**
* 3\-5 years of total work experience


**Mandatory Technical \& Functional Skills**

 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. title: Staff Network Engineer
description:

**We Are:**
 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

**You Are:**
 You are a highly skilled and motivated network engineer with a passion for designing, building, and maintaining world\-class network infrastructures. With over 8 years of hands\-on experience in complex enterprise environments, you have developed deep expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, and wireless technologies, as well as a strong command of Cisco and SDWAN solutions. You thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative, and globally distributed teams, always seeking new ways to optimize performance, security, and scalability. Your curiosity drives you to stay ahead of the latest trends in network automation and security, and you’re eager to upskill in emerging technologies like Zscaler and Palo Alto firewalls. You possess excellent troubleshooting abilities, a keen attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. Adaptable and resilient, you are comfortable working independently or as part of a team, and you bring clarity to complex technical challenges through effective communication. As someone who values integrity, execution excellence, leadership, and passion, you are committed to continuous improvement—both for yourself and for the organization. You’re excited by the opportunity to play a key role in supporting the infrastructure that powers global innovation at Synopsys, ensuring seamless connectivity, operational consistency, and superior user experiences in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Providing daily operational support for LAN, WAN, data center, and wireless networks to ensure robust and reliable connectivity across global offices.
* Troubleshooting user wired and wireless network connectivity issues, diagnosing root causes, and implementing effective solutions.
* Supporting the deployment and troubleshooting of IP networks for remote field offices and data centers.
* Managing network support ticketing, delivering timely resolutions, and maintaining high customer satisfaction for end\-user issues.
* Maintaining network design and configuration standards, ensuring operational consistency and compliance.
* Coordinating with vendors, partners, and service providers to resolve issues and optimize service delivery.
* Monitoring network stability and performance, ensuring 24x7 operations and rapid response to service impacts.
* Leading and collaborating with engineering peers on technical design solutions, contributing to high\-level (HLD) and low\-level (LLD) network documentation.
* Participating in network automation, upgrades, deployments, and design planning—including documentation updates and Visio diagrams.
* Participating in on\-call rotations, reviewing outages, and developing permanent fixes for recurring issues.
* Contributing to network documentation and knowledge base articles to foster knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.


**The Impact You Will Have:**
* Ensure seamless, secure, and high\-performance connectivity for Synopsys’ global operations, enabling innovation at scale.
* Drive rapid incident resolution and proactive problem management, minimizing downtime and business disruption.
* Enhance network reliability and scalability through robust design, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support business expansion and agility by enabling new office deployments and data center integrations worldwide.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging network technologies, strengthening Synopsys’ position as an industry leader.
* Facilitate effective cross\-functional collaboration, sharing expertise and driving knowledge transfer across teams.
* Champion best practices in network security, ensuring compliance and safeguarding Synopsys’ intellectual property.
* Empower colleagues and end\-users with responsive support and clear communication, fostering a culture of trust and reliability.


**What You’ll Need:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent relevant experience.
* Cisco certifications (CCNA, CCNP) and hands\-on SDWAN experience/certification.
* Exposure to data center environments, especially Cisco ACI Infrastructure.
* 8\+ years of experience supporting network infrastructures in small and large enterprise settings.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with BGP, OSPF, TCP/IP protocols, and deep knowledge of Cisco IOS/NX\-OS.
* Proficiency in configuring and supporting LAN, WAN, and wireless networks, with experience in large SDWAN deployments.
* Familiarity with network security solutions, including Palo Alto, Zscaler, Pulse Secure, and Aruba.
* Experience using network diagnostic and packet analysis tools.
* Ability and willingness to work after hours or weekends for project and maintenance activities.
* Bonus: Experience with network automation (scripting/coding) and advanced network security practices.


**Who You Are:**
* An analytical thinker and problem\-solver with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Adaptable and resilient, able to thrive in dynamic, global environments.
* Excellent communicator—both written and verbal—with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Collaborative team player who fosters knowledge sharing and mutual support.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently as well as within a team.
* Committed to integrity, execution excellence, leadership, and passion for technology.


**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**

title: Network and Application Security Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the strategy, governance, and operational management of enterprise edge platforms that provide content delivery, web application firewall (WAF), bot protection, DDoS mitigation, API security, and edge compute capabilities. This role ensures high availability, performance optimization and application\-layer protection for digital services.
   

  

 This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India, development center. You will be required to be on\-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on\-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You will lead the planning, design, and development of robust security architectures.
* You will oversee the deployment of network and system security measures while ensuring full alignment with corporate cybersecurity standards and protocols.
* You will monitor cybersecurity controls across LANs, WANs, VPNs, routers, firewalls, and other network infrastructure components.
* You will conduct security evaluations of applications and systems through penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and comprehensive risk analysis.
* You will Configure and deploy firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and other critical security technologies.
* You will have to apply software patches and updates to remediate system vulnerabilities and respond promptly to cybersecurity incidents and deliver detailed post\-incident reviews.
* You will have to investigate security breaches and perform thorough digital forensic analyses.


**About You**
* You should over 7\+years of relevant experience in network and application security engineering, including at least 5\+ years managing enterprise WAF platforms.
* You should have hands\-on expertise with bot management, fraud prevention solutions, and analyzing packet captures and application logs.
* Your background should include a minimum of 5years in cloud security architecture, with strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* You should be well‑versed in cloud\-native security guardrails, third‑party security tools, cloud networking, and IAM principles such as authentication and authorization.
* You also should have a solid understanding of application security, covering key protocols, cryptographic concepts, and edge security environments like CDNs.
* You should be passionate about cloud security, continuously learning and staying current with modern best practices and emerging technologies.
* You should be able to thrive in ambiguity, demonstrate strong ownership and urgency, and bring excellent communication, teamwork, and problem‑solving skills.
* You should cloud security certification such as AWS Security, ISC2 CCSP, or CSA CCSK is strongly preferred.


**Company Overview**
 McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 Amazon Physical Stores is a store with no lines and no checkout—you just grab and go! Customers use the Amazon Physical Stores app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go! Check it out at amazon.com/go.

You will need a strong ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.

You will be working on services with a direct impact on the customer experience. If you are excited about the opportunity to learn and work on networks, distributed systems, enjoy trouble shooting and solving complex problems, consider the opportunities to work with Amazon Physical Stores and the Just Walk Out Technology.
   

  

 You will help solve a variety of challenges and offer your expertise in growing the knowledge of your peers via team collaboration. We consistently whiteboard so be comfortable writing and supporting your ideas on the team board. You will play an active role in defining the support processes for technologies in partnership with other technology leaders within and possibly outside the team. Along the way, we guarantee that you'll work hard, have fun and impact many customers.

 Diverse Experiences

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams.  Mentorship and Career Growth

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About Freshlynn** 




  





 Freshlynn — Clean Smarter. Live Fresher.
 



  





 Freshlynn is India's first manufacturer of 4\-in\-1 Laundry Drops — a single drop that cleans, softens, brightens, and freshens your clothes. Born in Gujarat, built for the world.
 



  





 We didn't just create a product. We created a category. While the detergent industry has remained unchanged for decades, Freshlynn is rewriting the rules — delivering ultra\-concentrated, pre\-measured, zero\-waste laundry technology that is smarter, cleaner, and better for the planet.
 



  





 Today, we are India's fastest\-growing direct\-to\-consumer laundry brand, selling across India through our online store.
 



 Tomorrow, Freshlynn will be on the shelves of every kirana store (GT), every supermarket and hypermarket (MT), and in the homes of consumers across the globe.
 



  





 Our ambition is clear — to build an Indian consumer goods company that stands alongside the world's greatest FMCG giants. We are building the team, the systems, and the brand to get there.
 



  





 If you want to be part of India's most exciting laundry revolution — you're in the right place.
 



  




* Manufacturer \| D2C Online \| GT \& MT Expansion \| Global Vision \| Made in India



  





 Digital Marketing Manager — eCommerce \& Performance
 



 Full Time \| Ahmedabad, Gujarat \| eCommerce · FMCG
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for a results\-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead and scale Freshlynn's online presence across all digital channels. You will own our Meta Ads performance, content strategy, and brand growth — working directly with the founder to take India's first 4\-in\-1 Laundry Drops brand to the next level.
 



  





 This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership role in a fast\-growing D2C brand. If you love building brands from the ground up, obsess over ROAS, and want to be part of something truly first\-of\-its\-kind in India — this role is for you.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 



 • Plan, execute, and optimize Meta (Facebook \& Instagram) ad campaigns with a strong focus on ROAS and cost per purchase
 



 • Manage monthly ad budget of ₹5–15 lakhs across multiple campaigns
 



 • Build and manage retargeting, lookalike, and conversion campaigns end\-to\-end
 



 • Lead the content calendar — coordinating with designers and video editors for ad creatives
 



 • Analyze Shopify sales data and Meta Ads Manager performance daily and take action
 



 • Manage Google Ads, SEO, email and WhatsApp marketing campaigns
 



 • Track key metrics: ROAS, CPM, CTR, cost per purchase, return rate, and net revenue
 



 • Identify and fix funnel leaks — from ad impression to final purchase
 



 • Build and manage a small in\-house marketing team (designer, video editor, ads buyer)
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 • 2–4 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in D2C or eCommerce brands
 



 • Proven track record of managing Meta Ads with ROAS above 3x
 



 • Strong knowledge of Shopify analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Analytics
 



 • Experience managing monthly budgets of ₹3 lakhs or more
 



 • Ability to write compelling ad copy and brief creative teams
 



 • Data\-driven mindset — you make decisions based on numbers, not guesses
 



 • Self\-starter who can work independently and take full ownership
 



 • Bonus: Experience in FMCG, home care, or consumer goods brands
 



  





 WHAT WE OFFER
 



 • Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹45,000 per month (based on experience)
 



 • Direct mentorship from the founder
 



 • Opportunity to build and lead your own team
 



 • Be part of India's first 4\-in\-1 Laundry Drops company — a true category creator

title: Technical Writer
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 The Technical Writer is part of the Information Management team and plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between potentially complex technical information and the end users who need to understand and use it. They are responsible for creating clear and concise documentation such as production, maintenance and laboratory procedures, safety procedures, equipment manuals, and training materials. Their expertise lies in translating potentially intricate technical concepts into accessible language, ensuring that all content is accurate, up\-to\-date. Collaborating closely with engineers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders, Technical Writers ensure the integrity of the documentation, which is critical for the safe and efficient operation of LNG facilities..
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintenance of all facility production, maintenance and laboratory Operating Procedures, Work Instructions and Process \& Equipment Manuals, as well as HSE and Process Safety Manuals and Reports.
* Generate materials with input from SMEs and ensure that all documents are developed for their intended audience.
* Research engineering documentation, diagrams, corporate standards, and other regulations and standards to ensure sufficient compliance.
* Ensure that impact from MOCs, HAZOPs and other ABU processes are adequately captured and reflected in all affected documents.
* Ensure technical documents adhere to industry standards including Human and Organisation Performance (HOP) principles


**About You**
 5\+ years of relevant experience providing technical writing support and for a Complex Processing Facility (CPF) operating environment such as a Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) Facility, Refinery or Chemicals facility.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B. Tech) in relevant engineering discipline (mechanical, process, etc..) from a recognized (AICTE) university or trade/craft background
* High level of skill using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Visio and SharePoint, as well as Adobe Professional


**What We Can Offer You**
 Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
   

  

 Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
   

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well\-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well\-being, and work\-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.


**diversity, equity \& inclusion statement**

title: Technical Writer
description:
**BPM Overview:**
 What does BPM stand for? Innovation, opportunity, community, diversity, inclusivity, flexibility and so much more. B\-P\-M stands for “Because People Matter,” because at our core, our people drive everything we do and how we do it.
   

  

 We are a forward\-thinking, full\-service accounting firm providing modern solutions to businesses across the globe. We focus on comprehensive assurance, tax, and consulting services for our clients, and we provide our people and our community with the resources to lead meaningful and purposeful lives.
   

  

 While we are one of the largest California\-based accounting firms, our flexible work locations and schedules mean we have professionals across the continent. Our teams and our clients drive us to provide quality services and ignite unique insights and ideas that contribute to our continued success. Our clients come from different backgrounds and industries, which keep our people intellectually challenged every day.
   

  

 BPM India Advisory Service Private Limited \- Formerly known as “Burr Pilger Mayer India Private Limited”. (BPM India) is a subsidiary of BPM LLP. Founded in 1986, BPM is one of the largest California\-based accounting and consulting firms, ranking in the top 50 in the country. With 17 different office locations, BPM serves emerging and mid\-cap businesses as well as high\-net\-worth individuals in a broad range of industries, including financial services, technology, life science, manufacturing, food, wine and craft brewing, automotive, nonprofits, real estate and construction. The Firm’s International Tax Practice is one of the largest on the West Coast and its well\-recognized SEC practice serves approximately 35 public reporting companies, mostly in the technology industry.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with ETS leads to refine and establish standard documentation templates, naming conventions, and formatting guidelines for all ETS documentation categories.
* Serve as the primary owner of SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, policies, and practices across ETS.
* Maintain and enforce document governance including version control, approvals, lifecycle management, and content freshness.
* Review the entire existing ETS documentation catalog to identify gaps, outdated information, and modernization needs.
* Update legacy documentation to reflect current systems, tools, and processes.
* Create new documentation based on requests from ETS teams, PMO, or leadership.
* Work with SMEs across ETS to gather information through interviews, workshops, and recorded video walkthroughs.
* Convert SME‑created screen recordings into high‑quality SOPs, step‑by‑step guides, and process documents.
* Ensure documentation accurately reflects operational requirements and best practices.
* Use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, transcription tools, SD\+ or ITGlue AI features) to improve clarity, consistency, and structure; accelerate drafting and editing; extract steps and workflows from SME recordings.
* Create and manage documentation using ITGlue, ServiceDesk\+ (SD\+), and other ETS\-approved platforms.
* Build workflows, linkages, and structured documentation in ITGlue.
* Support integration of documentation into ITSM workflows when needed.
* Ensure documentation meets operational quality standards and aligns with audit‑ready expectations.
* Support optional compliance documentation (SOX, SOC, ISO) as needed.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality and follow security guidelines when handling sensitive or production\-related content.
* Work closely with PMO team (primary reporting line), ETS leads and managers, Operations \& Support teams, Infrastructure and application owners.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Mid‑level experience (5–7 years) in technical writing or IT documentation roles.
* Demonstrated experience writing SOPs, runbooks, process docs, and knowledge base articles.
* Familiarity with release notes and coding
* Ability to translate complex technical workflows into clear, concise documents.
* Experience collaborating with SMEs and conducting structured interviews.
* Proficiency with documentation tools such as ITGlue, SD\+, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar.
* Background in IT operations, ITSM, infrastructure, or enterprise technology.
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts or service management processes.
* Experience with AI‑powered documentation tools.
* Exposure to structured documentation in a PMO or ops\-focused environment.
* Exceptional command of written and spoken English (required).

* Ensuring technically accurate, high\-quality product documentation that meets requirements and is delivered on\-time.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering.
* Four or more years writing experience, preferably in the software industry.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your writing to conform to a corporate style guide.
* Adept at interviewing subject matter experts to gather the information needed to generate best\-in\-class content.
* Close attention to detail and strong multitasking abilities.
* General knowledge of software systems and a desire to understand software features.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a distributed team.


 What will give you an edge
   

  

 Additional skills that would make you stand out for this position include:
   

  

* Familiarity with the Microsoft Writing Style Guide.
* Experience working in an agile environment and using Jira for ticket progress tracking.
* Experience with the MadCap Flare Help authoring tool.
* Familiarity with UNIX or command\-line applications.
* Experience with version control systems (such as Git).
