title: Business Analyst, RBS : Cost to Serve
description:
**Description**
 About Amazon
   

  

 Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Through continuous innovation in selection, convenience, and low prices, Amazon has grown from an online bookstore into a global e\-commerce and technology leader. Our teams build solutions that improve how customers shop, how sellers grow, and how our global supply chain operates.
   

  

**About Retail Business Services (RBS)**
 RBS strengthens Amazon’s retail engine by driving standardization, improving process quality, and reducing defects across global marketplaces. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

**About Cost To Serve (CtS)**
 CtS is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon’s per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting systems, and automated data pipelines that support business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), pilot launches, and ongoing program governance.
* Own data infrastructure end\-to\-end—partner with tech, analytics, and operations teams to establish and maintain required tables, data lakes, and data structures that enable accurate and timely insights for APIE and related stakeholders.
* Retrieve, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple sources to produce actionable insights, KPI frameworks, and escalation deep dives that inform feature expansion, defect identification, and strategic decision\-making.
* Develop and maintain SQL queries and analytical models to support APIE feature performance, ad\-hoc requests, and dive\-deep investigations for operational or customer/vendor escalations.
* Enable data\-driven decision making by converting large datasets into digestible narratives, financial/CX estimates, and recommendations for pilots, experiments, and global expansions.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, build KPIs, automate processes, and drive data\-aligned solutions that meet evolving business needs.
* Prepare and deliver business reviews and written narratives for senior leadership, highlighting progress, insights, risks, and decision points.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions, providing analytical input that shapes long\-term product and operations strategy across global regions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience

description:
**Description**
 About Amazon
   

  

 Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Through continuous innovation in selection, convenience, and low prices, Amazon has grown from an online bookstore into a global e\-commerce and technology leader. Our teams build solutions that improve how customers shop, how sellers grow, and how our global supply chain operates.
   

  

**About Retail Business Services (RBS)**
 RBS strengthens Amazon’s retail engine by driving standardization, improving process quality, and reducing defects across global marketplaces. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

**About Cost To Serve (CtS)**
 CtS is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon’s per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision\-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting systems, and automated data pipelines that support business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), pilot launches, and ongoing program governance.
* Own data infrastructure end\-to\-end—partner with tech, analytics, and operations teams to establish and maintain required tables, data lakes, and data structures that enable accurate and timely insights for APIE and related stakeholders.

* Enable data\-driven decision making by converting large datasets into digestible narratives, financial/CX estimates, and recommendations for pilots, experiments, and global expansions.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, build KPIs, automate processes, and drive data\-aligned solutions that meet evolving business needs.
* Prepare and deliver business reviews and written narratives for senior leadership, highlighting progress, insights, risks, and decision points.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions, providing analytical input that shapes long\-term product and operations strategy across global regions.

title: Software Engineer, Content Onboarding
description:
**About Us**
 Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.
   

  

 In\-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in\-office workdays.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a product\-focused engineering role on Notion’s Content Onboarding team. You’ll build import and migration experiences that help individuals and enterprises bring existing content into Notion with high fidelity and reliability.
   

  

 You’ll work across the stack, partnering closely with product, design, and go\-to\-market teams to ship features end\-to\-end. The work spans user\-facing flows, backend systems for large data movement, and the operational tooling needed to diagnose and improve reliability at scale.
   

  

**What You'll Achieve**
* You’ll contribute to Notion's user growth by building a delightful user experience that enables users to seamlessly migrate their content from existing productivity tools.
* You’ll contribute to the overall design, scale, reliability and robustness of the systems responsible for moving large amounts of customer data into and out of Notion.
* You would be enabling Notion move upmarket by working with a team of engineers and cross\-functional partners across product, design \& professional services to reliably migrate some of Notion’s biggest Enterprise customers from third\-party applications.


**Skills You'll Need To Bring**
* Proven track record of execution: You have 5\+ years of engineering experience, including several years building world\-class product experiences alongside a team of engineers.
* Building the team: You enjoy collaborating with both fellow engineers and cross\-functional partners. You are a lifelong learner and invest in both your own growth, but also the growth, learning, and development of your teammates.
* Thoughtful problem\-solving: You approach problems holistically, starting with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You think critically about the implications of what you're building and how it will impact real people's lives. You can navigate ambiguity flawlessly, decompose complex problems into clean solutions, while also balancing the business impact of what you’re building.
* Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.
* Empathetic communication: You clearly communicate complex ideas to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders—whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. **About The Role**

 One of Sibros’ core products is to offer OTA (over\-the\-air) software updates to a fleet of vehicles. We believe all the new vehicles will have some form of connectivity to the cloud in a few years. * A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.

title: Sr. Manager Training
description:
**Description**  

**Sr. Manager Training**  

The Senior Manager Training is accountable in driving overall Training Performance across all assigned accounts. This position owns the effectiveness, efficiency, consistency of ResultsCX’s client training processes and initiatives within the Account Training span of control. Sr. Manager Training partners with Operations to provide necessary training intervention on performance gaps while coming up both short\-term to long\-term delivery plans to ensure strategies and tactics are executed against timelines, resources, process guidelines, competency requirements and expectations of Results and our partners.


**Role Requires: Onsite work, previous contact center, training, and healthcare vertical experience.**

  




**In this role you will:**  

* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Provide strategic support to Account Training Managers/Account Training Specialist and tactical support to Executives within the Training organization
* Identify the whole Account Training organization’s needs in staffing, budget, and general support, and creates/provides recommended solutions
* Be a global leader responsible in managing ResultsCX and clients’ training operations model/process and expectations and represents ResultsCX Training Team in both Operations senior leadership and client\-facing opportunities.
* Track, analyze, and report training effectiveness through agent life cycle performance: New Hire, Grad School and 0\-30 productions
* Communicate data\-driven findings, feedback, recommendations using multiple data references such as but not limited to attrition report, training satisfaction report, trainer observation and coaching report, training dashboard, QA report.
* Recommend necessary training intervention based on identified gaps which include but not be limited to training program content, bridge plans, governance steps, measured through improved class throughput, learner engagement, operations performance, and overall speed to proficiency
* Implement best in class training principles and methodologies in improving learning experience of New Hires from classroom training to grad school and operations through curriculum development, learning methodologies, grad school/learning lab playbook and training tools/technologies
* Partner with the Site Training Operations team and HR to create developmental programs for Trainers and Training staff
* Update program/site/region leadership and stakeholders on key strategic initiatives by building effective communication rhythms, strong partnership and client\-value add positioned for business growth
* Provide reviews and readouts showcasing impact of training\-led projects and initiatives (Effectively assess specific Success Measures prior to launching any training intervention, align with stakeholders on expected ROI, comprehensive readouts of post\-training impacts from the agreed upon Success Measures)
* Lead and represent training during launches and through effective project management, establishing communication channels, resource management, building travel plans and ensure effective partnership with other functional areas.
* Facilitate transformational learning solutions by applying world class learning principles and instructional design methodologies that drive success and effectiveness of training in all levels of evaluation: increased learning retention, improved learning experience, increase throughput, elevated performance, and improved overall speed to proficiency
* Develop existing leaderships (ATMs/ATS) and other high potential leaders by fostering their professional growth through regular coaching and feedback, certification, and immersions
* Champion training development programs and initiatives through client certifications, leadership programs, training observations, teach back, regular coaching and feedback while coming up with Performance Management Plan for direct reports to address performance gaps/opportunities
* Process governance of the overall training operating model which includes, ATM/ATS hiring and selection, onboarding processes, agent cycle handoffs, learning agreement, Daily Engagement Journals, certification process, Olympian travel, grad school playbook and training audits.
* Curriculum / Instructional Design audit and creation (Instructional design techniques, effective eLearning evaluation and design, utilization of virtual training creation platforms, appropriately assess training intervention strategy and appropriate design platform and implementation)

**We are looking for someone who has:**  

* Two or more years of successful management of training team (training delivery, instructional design, strategy)
* Experience with business process design/improvement, including gathering requirements, documenting workflows, and developing specifications.
* Advanced knowledge of Adult Learning Principles, Kirkpatrick’s Levels of Training Evaluation, and Instructional Methodologies. Degree preferred.
* Superior consulting skills, (e.g., critical thinking, problem solving, decision making, and influencing)
* Strong organization skills and ability to multi\-task in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* Ability to creatively use resources and adjust to changes quickly and professionally
* Ability to analyze data for trends and able to recognize opportunities for improvement both short\-term and long\-term
* Experience developing people and running teams
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, but also in a team environment
* Superb attention to details specially in the area of Project management of big to medium initiatives and projects
* Ability to provide on\-call support
* Strong relationship building skills with internal and external clients/ stakeholders
* Schedule flexibility (travel required both local and international)


Preferred Education and Experience


* Experience at ResultsCX
* Are of expertise on client\-specific training and requirements
* Knowledge of common analytics practices is a plus (Six Sigma)
* Instructional design certification

**About ResultsCX:**  

ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.

  



ResultsCX is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factors under federal, state, or local law.

* **Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.**

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.


Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.


We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data\-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.  



  

**The Role**

***As Talent Acquisition Specialist with Worley*** , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


The Global Talent Acquisition Operations Partner will play a critical role in supporting and optimizing the operational facets of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. This role will work closely with Regional TA Directors, TA Delivery teams, and global stakeholders to support and deliver key initiatives. This includes overseeing technology platforms, processes, training programs, vendor relationships, risk and compliance, privacy, and data integrity. The individual in this role will ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement of recruitment technologies and processes, while driving operational efficiency and ensuring global consistency and compliance.


* **Talent Acquisition Technology \& Systems Management:**
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to identify, optimize, and streamline the use of talent acquisition technology platforms (ATS, CRM, AI tools, job boards, staffing agencies, background check vendors, etc.) to gather insights and drive global and regional improvements in our TA tech stack and recruitment processes.
* **Process Management \& Continuous Improvement** :
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to develop, document, and refine regional talent acquisition processes ensuring consistency, efficiency, and alignment with global recruitment standards and practices.
	+ Develop continuous improvement recommendations using data insights, stakeholder feedback, and market best practices, to inform work and prioritization of improvement initiatives, applying modern and lean design principles.
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to lead and support initiatives focused on continuous process improvements aimed at enhancing overall end\-user experience, with a concentrated focus on candidate experience, hiring manager satisfaction, and recruiter productivity.
* **Project Management: Implementations \& Enhancements:**
	+ Support global projects and initiatives projects, in alignment with the Regional TA Director and Regional TA Delivery team to support the design, implementation, and optimization of new systems, tools, and processes that increase efficiency within the talent acquisition function.
	  
	
	Manage and deliver system upgrades, enhancements, and integrations to minimize disruptions and ensure high adoption rates, while measuring.
* **Vendor \& Supplier Management:**
	+ Support vendor relationships with external recruitment vendors, staffing agencies, job boards, and other third\-party suppliers, with input from Regional TA Delivery to inform desired outcomes and organizational priorities.
	+ Investigate and resolve TA vendor\-related inquiries and disputes.
* **Privacy, Compliance, \& Risk Management:**
	+ Support initiatives to assess, measure, manage, and mitigate risks associated with hiring processes, technologies, and vendor partnerships.
	  
	
	Partner with key stakeholders to lead and support process and performance audits to ensure data accuracy, efficiency, adoption, and utilization of TA processes and technology.
* **Training \& Development:**
	+ Provide ongoing training related to technology, compliance, and recruitment best practices.
* **Issue Resolution \& Support:**
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for resolving any issues related to talent acquisition operations, such as system errors, vendor disputes, and/or process inefficiencies.
	+ Work cross\-functionally with the Regional TA Delivery teams to address operational challenges and provide timely, effective solutions to TA Operations, Digital, and Process Teams.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* A minimum of 3 years’ experience successfully leading process assessments, audits, and continuous improvement efforts in Talent Acquisition.
* A minimum of 2 years; experience supporting or leading the design and implementation of AI systems and tools, driving process optimization and adoption.
* Strong knowledge of global compliance regulations, data privacy laws, and risk management practices within the recruitment space.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and/or third\-party service agreements.
* Project management skills with the ability to oversee multiple initiatives and drive them to successful completion.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Advanced data analysis and interpretation skills to derive insights from data and convert them into recommendations for improvement.
* Proven track record of leading and implementing process improvements, technology upgrades, and training initiatives.
* Experience designing and/or implementing Eightfold.
* Experience with ATS system design and management.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Prior experience in recruitment.

**Moving forward together**

title: HR Manager
description:
**Company Overview**

Cyberchrome Private Limited is a fast\-growing IT and business development company focused on building structured, scalable systems for startups and premium clients. We specialize in business development solutions, digital infrastructure, and strategic growth support.

We are transitioning from a local service model to a **premium client\-focused organization**, and we are looking for a strong HR leader to build and manage a professional workforce system.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Deep understanding of organizational structure and HR systems
* Ability to handle pressure and enforce discipline
* Strategic thinking \+ execution capability

**Role Objective**

The HR Head will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the entire HR system of Cyberchrome. This role is focused on building a **structured, disciplined, and performance\-driven team culture** aligned with business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. HR System Development

* Design and implement complete HR policies and SOPs
* Build a structured organizational hierarchy (Team Leaders, Departments, Reporting flow)
* Develop employee lifecycle systems (Hiring → Onboarding → Performance → Exit)
* Ensure the company operates in a **system\-driven structure, not person\-dependent**

2\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Plan and execute hiring strategies for all departments
* Create job descriptions and hiring pipelines
* Conduct interviews and shortlist high\-quality candidates
* Focus on hiring **growth\-oriented and disciplined professionals**

3\. Performance Management System

* Implement KPI\-based performance tracking
* Monitor employee productivity and efficiency
* Coordinate with team leaders for performance reviews
* Develop reward, incentive, and penalty systems

4\. Employee Discipline \& Culture

* Maintain strict professional communication systems
* Ensure no direct dependency between employees and top management (structured communication only through team leaders)
* Build a **high\-performance, no\-nonsense work culture**
* Handle employee conflicts and disciplinary actions

5\. Training \& Development

* Identify skill gaps and organize training programs
* Develop onboarding training systems for new employees
* Improve team productivity through continuous learning

6\. Payroll \& Compliance

* Manage salary structures, attendance, and leave systems
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies
* Coordinate with accounts for payroll processing

7\. HR Analytics \& Reporting

* Track hiring metrics, employee performance, and retention rates
* Provide regular reports to management
* Suggest improvements based on data

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ernakulam, Kerala

**Description**

Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**


Core Responsibilities:

* Lead deployment of global HR policies across assigned country/countries, ensuring compliance with local laws and cultural relevance.
* Partner with HR CoEs and Legal to conduct impact assessments and oversee policy localization.
* Oversee HR\-related audits, inspections, and statutory reporting.
* Provide country leadership and HRBPs with insights into compliance trends, risk exposure, and legislative changes.
* Act as a strategic advisor to HRBPs, CoEs, and country leadership to align people initiatives with business goals.
* Drive strategic workforce planning, organizational design, and change management efforts.
* Represent the country in global HR initiatives, ensuring feasibility and alignment.
* Serve as escalation point for complex employee relations cases (T3 escalations).
* Manage relationships with employee representative bodies (e.g., Works Councils, Trade Unions).
* Monitor and improve employee lifecycle processes for compliance and efficiency.
* Own Workday knowledge base content for the assigned country.
* Lead deployment of culture and engagement initiatives.
* Provide people data and analytics to support HR and business decisions.
* Mentor and develop HR team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance culture


Qualifications \& Education Requirements:

* Minimum 4 Year / Bachelor's Degree: Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Employment Law, Business Administration, or a related field, Master’s degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of progressive HR experience across HR compliance, employee relations, and policy advisory, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership capacity.


Additional Qualifications:

* Strong knowledge of employment law, data privacy, and labor relations within the country.
* CIPD Level 7 or equivalent HR certification preferred.
* Experience managing HR teams and influencing across HRBP, Legal, and Compliance functions.
* Proven track record in country\-level HR audits, policy harmonization, and ER case management.
* Skilled in designing governance frameworks and risk mitigation strategies.
* Strong interpersonal and advisory skills to influence senior stakeholders.
* Proficient in data analysis and metrics\-driven decision\-making.
* Fluency in local language(s) and business\-level English.

title: Business Consulting - Product Owner - Data Platform (Incentive Compensation / Varicent Program)
description:
**Req ID:** 363102
  

  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.  

  

We are currently seeking a Business Consulting \- Product Owner \- Data Platform (Incentive Compensation / Varicent Program) to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN\-TN), India (IN).  

  

**Job Description:**  

  

**Role Overview**  

  

We are seeking an experienced **Product Owner \- Data Platform** with strong domain expertise in **Incentive Compensation Planning (ICP)** to drive product strategy, roadmap execution, and value realization for the enterprise Data Platform supporting the Varicent program.  

  

This role will ensure the data platform reliably powers complex compensation processes including:  

* Sales crediting and adjustments
* Hierarchy management
* Quota and territory alignment
* Incentive plan modeling
* Earnings and payout calculations
* Retro adjustments and clawbacks
* Audit, traceability, and compliance

  

The ideal candidate combines **deep ICP business understanding** with experience in **modern cloud\-based data platforms, Medallion architecture, Data Vault modeling, and governed data exposure strategies**.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**1\. Product Vision \& ICP\-Aligned Strategy**  

* Define and own the **Data Platform product vision** aligned to enterprise Incentive Compensation strategy.
* Ensure the platform supports:
* + Accurate and timely compensation calculations
	+ Full auditability and lineage for payout traceability
	+ Scenario modeling and simulation needs
	+ Secure handling of sensitive compensation data
* Build and maintain a multi\-quarter roadmap covering:
* + ICP data ingestion and transformation pipelines
	+ Medallion architecture maturity (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers)
	+ Data Vault implementation for compensation entities
	+ Secure and scalable data exposure for Varicent and downstream systems
* Prioritize initiatives based on business impact (e.g., payout accuracy, cycle time reduction, dispute reduction).

  

**2\. ICP Data Domain Ownership**  

  

Act as the product authority for compensation\-related data domains, including:  

* Sales transactions \& bookings
* Crediting rules \& split logic
* Sales hierarchies and territory structures
* Quotas \& targets
* Incentive plan definitions
* Earnings \& payout calculations
* Adjustments, clawbacks, and disputes
* Historical compensation audit data

  

Ensure data models and transformations support:  

* Retroactive recalculations
* Period\-based compensation cycles
* Versioned plan structures
* Hierarchy changes over time
* Regulatory and financial compliance requirements

  

Collaborate closely with Data Architects to ensure Data Vault modeling properly represents ICP business keys (e.g., employee, plan, position, territory, transaction).  

  

**3\. Backlog Ownership \& Delivery Execution**  

* Own and manage the **Data Platform backlog** across:
* + Compensation data ingestion pipelines (batch \& streaming)
	+ Data validation and reconciliation frameworks
	+ Data quality rules specific to ICP logic
	+ Lakehouse architecture enablement (Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift)
	+ Secure data access models (RBAC for sensitive compensation data)
* Write clear epics and user stories translating ICP requirements into technical deliverables.
* Ensure each feature supports:
* + Traceability
	+ Reproducibility of payouts
	+ SLA adherence for compensation cycles
* Balance technical enablers (e.g., metadata, lineage, observability) with business\-driven features.

  

**4\. Data Exposure \& Consumption Strategy (Compensation\-Focused)**  

* Define product strategy for governed data exposure to:
* + Varicent
	+ BI \& reporting tools
	+ Finance systems
	+ Audit \& compliance teams
* Ensure compensation data is:
* + Securely shared
	+ Masked/tokenized where required
	+ Accessible through controlled semantic layers
* Enable analytics use cases such as:
* + Earnings forecasting
	+ Incentive plan performance analysis
	+ Sales performance insights
	+ Compensation cost modeling
* Define and track SLAs for compensation data availability during payout cycles.

  

**5\. Governance, Audit \& Compliance Alignment**  

  

Given the sensitive nature of compensation data:  

* Embed governance and audit principles into platform prioritization.
* Ensure support for:
* + Data lineage from source transaction to final payout
	+ Historical snapshotting and versioning
	+ Dispute investigation workflows
	+ Role\-based data access (field rep vs manager vs finance vs HR)
* Partner with InfoSec and compliance teams to enforce:
* + Encryption (at rest \& in transit)
	+ Zero\-trust access principles
	+ Data masking and tokenization
	+ Regulatory compliance requirements

  

**6\. Metrics \& Value Realization**  

  

Define and track KPIs such as:  

* Payout accuracy rate
* Compensation dispute volume
* Cycle time for compensation processing
* Data quality scores for ICP entities
* Platform uptime during compensation runs
* Adoption of standardized data models

  

Drive continuous improvements in compensation transparency and trust.  

  

**Required Skills \& Expertise**  

  

**Incentive Compensation Domain (Mandatory)**  

* Strong experience in **Incentive Compensation Planning (ICP)**.
* Deep understanding of:
* + Sales crediting logic
	+ Hierarchies and territory management
	+ Quota management
	+ Plan design structures
	+ Earnings calculations and payout processing
	+ Retro adjustments and audit requirements
* Experience working with compensation platforms such as **Varicent** (strongly preferred).
* Understanding of financial controls and audit needs related to compensation.

  

**Product \& Delivery Expertise**  

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Ownership / Product Management.
* Proven ownership of enterprise data or platform products.
* Strong Agile backlog management and roadmap planning expertise.
* Experience operating in cross\-functional enterprise environments.

  

**Data Platform \& Technical Understanding**  

  

Strong conceptual understanding of:  

* Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
* Data Vault 2\.0 (Hubs, Links, Satellites)
* Lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
* Batch and streaming architectures
* APIs and semantic layers
* Metadata, lineage, and observability frameworks
* Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)

  

Strong data literacy (SQL proficiency preferred).  

  

**Security \& Governance Awareness**  

* IAM / RBAC best practices
* Data masking and encryption standards
* Secure data sharing frameworks
* Governance frameworks for regulated and financial\-sensitive data

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience leading ICP transformations or compensation system migrations.
* Experience in Sales Performance Management (SPM) programs.
* CSPO / SAFe POPM certification.
* Experience in regulated or publicly traded enterprises.

  

**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**  

* Ability to translate complex compensation logic into scalable platform capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder management across Sales, Finance, HR, IT, and Architecture.
* High attention to detail and audit mindset.
* Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams in matrixed organizations.

  

**Success Criteria**  

* Reliable and auditable ICP data platform supporting Varicent.
* Reduction in compensation disputes due to improved data transparency.
* Secure and governed compensation data exposure framework.
* Standardized modeling approach adopted across ICP domains.
* High stakeholder confidence in payout accuracy and traceability.

This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-First Mindset: A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

 **NOTE**


Comfortable working in a hybrid office environment (3 days minimum) plus working US\-business hours (EST/PST time zones).

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

title: Outlet Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Outlet Manager

**Location:** Ahmedabad Airport

**About Us:** Zivaya is a chain of luxury wellness outlets major chains of hotels, palaces, airports and lounges across India. We offer premium therapies, beauty, spa \& hair treatments.

**Job Description:**

As an Outlet Manager, you will be responsible for the QUALITY \& REVENUE of the outlet. From describing our services to the consumer to ensuring that the place and staff looks tidy,collecting payments from the guests, and upselling services, you are required to take complete ownership of the outlet.

**Timings**\-while the outlet will run for 24 hours, and you will handle the main shift, as a manager, you will still be required to monitor the operations online at random times, and collect reports to ensure quality of our services. You might have to work in rotational shifts depending on the needs of the business. Your success will depend on how well you can make it run even in your absence. Any glitches and misses will still be your responsibility, as a manager.

**Quality**\-ensuring all systems and processes are implemented, all SOPs adhered to; deliver world\-class quality \& service, and achieve high customer satisfaction. This would involve completely managing operations\-handling appointments, hygiene, coordinating with outside agencies for support to avoid gaps in services. A detailed\-oriented approach will be needed to deliver an unmatched customer experience.

**Revenue**\-daily revenue collection \& booking in respective heads and reconciliation, achieve the targeted revenue by ensuring relevant branding at the outlet, and cross\-promotions with relevant brands and agencies inside the airport. As an outlet manager, you will be required to interact with the relevant customers inside the lounge to familiarize them with our services and offers; you will also have to maintain business relationships with major stakeholders at the airport that can help in the increase of guest inflow at the outlet.

**Experience**\-previous experience in customer service, guest engagement, sales and operations (hospitality, F\&B, aviation, banking, retail, beauty) preferred. Proven track\-record of achieving high guest satisfaction \& sales is a plus. Ability to handle conflicts within the team, and being able to constantly motivate them for high performance will be a key to success in this industry.

**Expectations**\-a highly disciplined individual with strong communication skills and a go\-getter attitude, ability to handle a team of 8\-10 people, strong work ethics and someone who can manage relationships across multiple departments. A strong preference will be given to anybody at airport bank/credit card retail sales who are used to reaching out to the audience for engagement.

A strong sense of **PROFESSIONALISM**. Due to the nature of the business and multiple\-stakeholders, we need strong candidates with strong integrity who might also be required to sign a document/cheque that might require the candidate to take full responsibility of cash \& revenue handling and its proper reconciliation. We prefer professional candidates who are non\-smokers.

**Growth**\-we offer strong visibility and opportunities of growth. This would come in the form of competitive compensation, incentives,freebies, and more.

title: Teacher- Digital Skills
description:
Akanksha is on a mission to build one of the largest and most innovative networks of schools in India, serving children from low\-income communities, to maximize their potential. Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. Over the last 30 years, Akanksha has been at the forefront of proving what’s possible for children from low\-income communities in Mumbai \& Pune. Our 5,100 alumni are on the path to living an empowered life. Today Akanksha runs 26 schools in partnership with governments of Mumbai, Pune, Pimpri\-Chinchwad, Navi Mumbai and Nagpur serving \~14,000 children in grades Jr Kg \- Gr 10\.

**Position: Computer Teacher**

**Function/Team:** Akanksha

**School Location:** Seawoods (Navi Mumbai)

**Compensation:** Based on skill sets, experience and sector standards

**Reports to:** School Leader

**Position Summary:**

As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 40 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students toward academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their lives. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. You will work with grades 3\-10 to implement our digital skills and computer science curriculum.

**Overview of the Team:**

The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai . These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

**What your role will entail:**

● Teaching the Akanksha curriculum through effective pedagogical practices

● Designing and executing lesson plans that will engage students

● Designing assessments that thoughtfully evaluate student progress

● Varying teaching strategies and styles to meet different learning needs

● Providing a positive environment to engage students in the learning process

● Establishing and maintaining a co\-operative working relationships with students, parents, community and the school team

● Clearly articulating high expectations for students

● Creating and maintaining an aesthetically positive environment

● Actively participating in network opportunities for professional development

● Attending and participating in all school training and meetings

● Meeting professional obligations through efficient work habits

● Actively participating in all extra\-curricular and celebratory activities in school

● Making occasional community visits to stay connected with parents

● Observe other team members to learn more about the school culture, classroom management, content and skill execution

● Working collaboratively with the Digital Learning Core Team at Akanksha

● Coordinating with the School/IT team to set up and manage the required device infrastructure at the school

● Supporting schools and teachers to integrate digital skills in other subjects.

What you need for this Position

**Experience**

● Candidates with prior education/certification/experience in computer science / IT can apply

● Past teaching experience is preferred but freshers also encouraged to apply

**Education**

● BCS, MCS, BCA, MCA, B.Sc./MSc. in CS, B.Tech/MTech in CS are preferred.

● Graduates from other streams may also be considered provided with relevant experience in computer science / IT.

● B.Ed. preferred (not mandatory)

* Knowledge for Python ,C\+\+,Java and any other coding language good to have.

**Knowledge/Skills:**

● Strong content knowledge and expertise

● Love for children and learning

● Adaptability to new instructional approaches

● Patience and capacity to solve problems

● Good planning and organizing skills

● Strong team player

● Self\-motivated with strong work ethics to achieve school goals

● Openness to feedback and critical reflection

● Strong oral and written communication skills in English

● Sharp knowledge and understanding of computer science and digital skills

CPU spikes

Disk I/O issues

Network anomalies

Work on incident response and root cause analysis (RCA)

Reduce MTTR through proactive improvements

️ Monitoring Stack Ownership

Design and maintain a complete monitoring stack, including:

Prometheus

Grafana

ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)

Loki

Integrate monitoring with infrastructure and applications

Ensure high availability and scalability of monitoring systems

Required Skills

Strong hands\-on with:

Prometheus

Grafana (dashboard \+ alerting design)

ELK Stack / Loki

Deep understanding of:

System metrics (CPU, Memory, Disk, Network)

Application monitoring concepts

Experience in setting up monitoring from scratch

Good understanding of Linux systems

Basic scripting (Shell / Python)

Experience with Kubernetes monitoring (Prometheus Operator, etc.)

Knowledge of OpenTelemetry / distributed tracing

Exposure to automation and self\-healing systems

Understanding of high\-scale production environments

Not just “monitoring” — ownership mindset

Can correlate metrics \+ logs to find real issues

Can take action, not just escalate

Thinks in terms of reliability, not just dashboards

Someone who can grow into a full SRE role quickly

 The DSMM statistician will follow the globally consistent methodology but is expected to have a high level of initiative and creativity and suggest enhancements to the current methodologies. The role requires working closely with business partners based in other geographies that Citi operates in (e.g., NAM, APAC, and LATAM).
   

  

 Requirements include a background in analysis using databases, warehouses, data processing, experience with statistics and data mining. Experience and knowledge in banking and finance, especially in the AML area will be a plus. In addition, the ability to read and create formal documentation is highly desirable.

description:
Viacom India is seeking an experienced **Full Stack WordPress Developer/Designer** with 1\-2\+ years of professional experience. The ideal candidate will be proficient in both front\-end and back\-end WordPress development, including the creation, customization, and optimization of themes and plugins. This role requires a strong focus on performance optimization, responsiveness, and seamless user experience, along with technical troubleshooting and ensuring compliance with web standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **WordPress Development \& Customization:**
* Develop, customize, and maintain WordPress themes and plugins according to client specifications.
* Implement custom WordPress themes from design mockups using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
* Optimize websites for speed, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Ensure mobile\-friendly and responsive design across all devices.
* Troubleshoot bugs, performance issues, and technical challenges.
* Maintain website security, compliance with web standards, and ensure functionality.
* Implement SEO best practices and ensure cross\-browser compatibility.
* Integrate APIs, third\-party services, and databases.
* Work with sitemaps and Google Analytics for tracking and analysis.
* **Front\-End Development:**
* Implement user interfaces based on design specifications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, React, or Vue.js.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.
* Optimize front\-end performance for fast loading and smooth user interaction.
* **Back\-End Development:**
* Manage WordPress backend, including database integration (MySQL) and server\-side scripting (PHP).
* Customize the WordPress admin panel and dashboard for ease of content management.
* Integrate third\-party APIs (e.g., payment gateways, social media APIs).
* Manage website security, backups, and server\-related troubleshooting.
* **Performance Optimization:**
* Use performance optimization techniques such as image compression, caching, and minimizing server load.
* Conduct site audits to resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Utilize tools like Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, and GTmetrix to improve speed and SEO.
* **Security Management:**
* Implement secure coding practices and regularly update software.
* Install and monitor security plugins to detect vulnerabilities.
* Manage secure authentication, user roles, and permissions.
* **Debugging \& Troubleshooting:**
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve website issues (e.g., bugs, crashes, UX problems).
* Perform regular testing to ensure cross\-device and browser compatibility.
* **SEO \& Analytics:**
* Implement SEO best practices in code structure to enhance visibility.
* Use Google Analytics and other tools to track website performance.
* Apply schema markup, metadata, and other SEO enhancements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 1\-2\+ years of proven experience in WordPress development (front\-end \& back\-end).
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL.
* Experience with theme and plugin development/customization.
* Familiarity with responsive design principles.
* Experience with WordPress page builders (e.g., Elementor, WPBakery) and frameworks.
* Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Proficiency in website optimization techniques (e.g., caching, CDNs, minification).
* Strong understanding of SEO best practices.
* Experience with hosting environments, FTP, cPanel, and command\-line tools.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.

**Preferred Skills (Optional):**

* Experience with Media Industery or other eCommerce platforms.
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Knowledge of web hosting environments and basic server management.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on diverse and challenging projects.
* Be part of a collaborative and dynamic work environment.
* Competitive salary with growth opportunities.

**Candidate Assignment:**  
As part of the application process, candidates must complete the following assignment:

* **Task: Replicate the Home Page of www.viacomindia.com**
* Recreate the homepage within WordPress, ensuring the following elements are replicated accurately:
* **Header:** Include company logo and navigation menu matching the original layout and design.
* **Hero Banner/Slider:** Create a full\-width hero section with a background image/video, overlay text, and buttons, mirroring the original page.
* **Featured Services/Content:** Design sections showcasing key services or projects, with appropriate styling, icons, or images.
* **Portfolio/Video Section:** Implement a section displaying projects or videos, with text descriptions and links to more information.
* **Footer:** Recreate the footer with contact details, social media links, and legal/privacy links.
* Ensure the website is:
* Fully responsive across all devices (desktop, tablet, and mobile).
* Optimized for speed using basic WordPress optimization techniques (e.g., image compression, caching).

Reporting to a Director\-level leader, this role partners closely with operations, business units, finance, and WFM teams to ensure the workforce strategy enables operational readiness, scalability, and long\-term growth. This position is ideal for a leader who thrives in complexity, can translate business strategy into executable workforce plans, and drives alignment across multiple stakeholders and geographies.
   

  

 What you'll do...
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Workforce Planning team within Customer Engagement Services (CES) ensures the right workforce is in place to support Walmart’s customer care operations at scale. The Senior Manager, Workforce Planning plays a critical role in shaping and delivering network\-wide workforce strategies that support peak volumes, business expansion, and structural change. This role owns cross\-functional workforce planning programs that span multiple sites, channels, and lines of business. Rather than owning a single forecast, this leader ensures that major initiatives—such as peak readiness, new business launches, and site transitions—are successfully planned, integrated into WFM processes, and executed with minimal disruption to service and productivity.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead large\-scale, network\-wide workforce planning initiatives including peak planning and execution, new business stand\-up, and integration into workforce management.
* Own end\-to\-end workforce planning for new site openings, closures, and headcount transitions, ensuring operational readiness and minimal service disruption.
* Drive annual and intra\-year peak planning efforts, aligning demand forecasts, capacity plans, hiring strategies, and execution timelines across the network.
* Partner closely with operations, business units, recruiting, training, finance, data science, and WFM teams to translate business strategy into executable workforce plans.
* Monitor execution performance for major workforce initiatives, proactively identifying risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation strategies.
* Lead scenario planning and risk modeling for volume volatility, ramp curves, and capacity constraints.
* Communicate workforce strategies, assumptions, and outcomes clearly to senior leadership to enable informed decision\-making.
* Establish governance, standard processes, and documentation to improve consistency, scalability, and planning rigor.
* Analyze outcomes of workforce initiatives to identify root causes, drive continuous improvement, and strengthen future planning.


**What You'll Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Analytics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* 14 – 20 years of experience in workforce planning, capacity planning, operations strategy, or large\-scale program leadership.
* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional workforce initiatives across multiple sites or business units.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Deep understanding of workforce management concepts, forecasting, capacity modeling, and operational execution.
* Experience supporting large contact center, retail, or service\-based operations at scale is strongly preferred.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.


**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. Thats what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Were a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the worlds leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our \[Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Benefits Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

**Belonging**
 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

title: HR Manager – People & Culture
description:
We’re hiring an HR Manager, but not in the traditional sense.
   








 We don’t need someone to “manage HR”.
   

 We need someone who can
 **build a strong team and culture while we scale fast** 
 .
   





 About Us
   


 We’re a growing SaaS company working in the eCommerce and ERP space. The company is at a stage where things are moving fast — hiring is constant, teams are evolving, and structure is still being built.
   





 This role is important because
 **how we scale people will define how we scale the company** 
 .
   




 What This Role Is Really About
   


 At its core, this role has two clear responsibilities:
   

  




 1\. Build and protect the culture
   

  

  


 We want to build a company that is:
   




* Accountable
* Transparent
* People\-friendly (not political)
* Performance\-driven



 Your job is to
 **make sure this doesn’t break as we grow** 
 .
   








 This is not about running engagement activities.
   

 It’s about:
   





* Listening to people
* Spotting problems early
* Having difficult conversations when needed
* Helping managers become better leaders


 2\. Own hiring end\-to\-end
   

  

  


 You will own hiring outcomes.
   





 You will have a recruiter, but you are responsible for:
   




* Speed of hiring
* Quality of hires
* Candidate experience



 You’ll work closely with founders and team leads to:
   




* Define roles clearly
* Improve interview processes
* Ensure we’re hiring the right people, not just filling positions


 What You’ll Actually Be Doing
   

* Talking to people across teams and understanding what’s working / not working
* Helping resolve team or manager\-level issues
* Driving hiring across roles (tech \+ non\-tech)
* Improving onboarding so new hires don’t feel lost
* Helping define roles, expectations, and performance clarity
* Supporting managers in handling underperformance
* Putting basic systems in place (without overcomplicating things)


 Requirements
   

  

 What We Care About
   


 We’re not looking for the “perfect HR profile”.
   





 We care more about how you think and operate.
   




* You take ownership without waiting to be told
* You’re comfortable in a slightly unstructured environment
* You can balance empathy with firmness
* You’re okay having uncomfortable conversations
* You don’t hide behind policies


 This Role Will Not Work If
   

* You prefer structured MNC environments
* You rely heavily on policies and processes
* You avoid conflict or difficult conversations
* You need everything to be clearly defined before you act


 Experience
   

* 5\+ years in HR
* Experience in hiring and employee engagement
* Startup or fast\-growing company experience is a plus


 Why This Role Exists
   


 Right now, a lot of people\-related decisions sit with the founders.
   





 We want someone who can:
   




* Take ownership of this area
* Bring clarity
* Help us scale without losing what makes the company work


 Benefits
   

  

 What You Get
   

* Direct exposure to founders
* High ownership (not just execution)
* Opportunity to build things from scratch
* A fast learning environment



 If you’re someone who wants to
 **actually build a company from the inside** 
 , this role will be meaningful.

title: Human Resource People Partner
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 You will facilitate core People Partner processes across Avalara's India operations. You will provide proactive, high\-judgment support to People Partners and first\-line managers, including employee lifecycle changes, policy application, data quality and reporting, and termination and offboarding processes.
   

  

 As an HR People Partner career\-level individual contributor, you are a HR professional with a full understanding of your area of specialization. You can resolve issues in creative, practical ways. Avalara expects you to model its P\&C expectations, Avalara's culture embodies you, and you raise the bar for quality, judgment, and execution in every interaction.
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Business partnering**
* Take lead and direction from the Senior People Partner to implement the people strategy for the business, translating high\-level direction into clear plans and actions for your scope.
* Provide daily guidance to first\-line managers on people topics. These topics include department changes, employee relations, performance management, talent reviews, change programs, and more. Ensure that all actions conform to regulatory and legislative requirements.
* Challenge constructively and directly. Be respectful, fact\-based, and willing to question the status quo. This approach roots itself in ownership and a genuine commitment to raising performance.
* Partner with Centers of Excellence, such as Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, TM/LD, HR Services, and Legal, to resolve issues end\-to\-end.
* Be a primary contact for people\-related queries within your client groups, evaluation, resolving, or routing to People Partners.


**HR proficiency and operational excellence**
* Lead and contribute to projects that promote People Partner goals and programs in India (e.g., performance management, position eliminations execution support, policy changes, or programs driven through ServiceNow ticketing and Workday).
* Support implementation of people programs and policies through communications planning, project management, partner education, and high\-quality documentation.
* Maintain knowledge of India employment law and compliance requirements and apply them pragmatically in partnership with People Partners and Employee Relations.
* Be an primary liaison with business/departments on ER matters (performance issues, accommodations, policy violations, job eliminations), escalating to Senior or Global People Partners and Legal.
* Provide accurate and well\-documented administrative and tactical support to People Partners (e.g., Workday changes, documentation, letters, audits, and employee records).


**AI\-first mindset and data**
* Connect structure, capability, performance, reward, and culture to design simple, scalable, AI\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes at enterprise level
* Use data (workforce, ticketing, ER trends, performance outcomes) to define problems, measure progress, and recommend trade\-offs; treat anecdotes as context, not direction.
* Use AI tools, such as Avi, Co\-pilot, and ChatGPT, to automate repeatable work. Additionally, use HR systems like Workday, ServiceNow, and HRIS/ATS to enhance employee experience.


**Storytelling, communication, and culture**
* Explain the “why”, trade\-offs, and expected outcomes of people decisions, linking them to our goals and employee experience


 You will report to Director, People Partner
   

  

 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* Experience:
+ Minimum 4\+ years of HR experience in a global organization
+ Master's degree in Human Resources
+ Experience supporting India\-based employee populations and partnering with global stakeholders strongly preferred.

* Technical skills:
+ Experience with HR systems (e.g., Workday, HRIS, ATS) and collaboration tools (Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack).
+ Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Avi) to drive efficiency, insight, and better employee/manager experiences.

* Professional skills and traits:
+ Demonstrated urgency, ownership, curiosity, humility, and passion for building a high\-performance, fair, and fun culture.
+ Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and maintain strong documentation and audit\-ready records.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

* Strategic and systems thinking capability
* Comfort with automation, digital tools, and evolving HR technologies

**About Us**
**Our People, Our Culture**
 For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI\-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle.
